title: pm-dispatch SKILL.md: the seat invariant still names MCP rerun_failed_jobs as the one allowed MCP write, while a re-run leaves only through the relay
body:
security#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYn5CmmdShCJifm6WYj

## What

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (全体座位的不变量, ~line 94) reads 「内容写只走 REST 代理,⛔ 无 MCP 写,唯一例外 `rerun_failed_jobs`(限 CI 红单次重跑,先核 head)」. That is a standing MCP write exception.

Everything else on `main` routes the one re-run through the relay:
- `platform-readings.md` (~line 288) routes it through `scripts/pm/rerun-failed.mjs`;
- that tool's header (~lines 48–52) is relay-only: "there is no direct path";
- the relay mints `actions: write` for that stroke alone (`run_rerun_failed` in `scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`);
- AGENTS.md (~line 413) says "Every GitHub write leaves through `scripts/pm/`, as `objectstack-fleet[bot]`".

The SKILL.md exception is therefore stale text that still reads as a permission.

Found by the contract review of PR #30155 (card #30111), whose dev noted it as out of scope. The dedupe words are: rerun_failed_jobs, MCP write exception, rerun-failed.mjs, run_rerun_failed.

## Acceptance

- SKILL.md's invariant names no MCP write exception. The one CI-red re-run goes through `rerun-failed.mjs` (the relay), and the head is checked first.
- `platform-readings.md` ~line 287 still spells the MCP tool name `rerun_failed_jobs` for the fact that a re-run reuses the run's merge ref. Respell it so it names the relay's re-run, and keep the fact.
- SKILL.md is at headroom 0, so the edit pays for itself within the file's ceiling. ⛔ No ceiling raise without a maintainer ruling.
